title: Austin Confirms New Mayor & Districts
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   The city officially certified the results of the December 13 runoff election.
*   Kirk Watson was formally declared Austin's new Mayor after winning the mayoral race.
*   New City Council members were confirmed for Districts 3, 5, and 9: Jose Velasquez (District 3), Ryan Alter (District 5), and Zahi Qadri (District 9).
*   The election results were approved unanimously, making the new leadership official.
